text:
Sam (marketing): Need a mini-bench for launch: redwood-2-small, ctx=1024, single-session interactive (~20 tokens) + a 5-user throughput datapoint. Want p50/p95/p99 token latencies, tokens/sec, cold vs warm, FP16 baseline + one quantized variant (int8). Please include raw CSV histograms and the seed list.

Daniel (eng-runtime): We can run that. Plan: 3 cold restarts for cold variance, then warm runs of ~10k tokens with continuous batching OFF to mimic single-session pacing. Will capture token timing, KV cache hit rate, and GPU power profile.

Daniel (eng-runtime): We'll record provenance (docker tag, commit sha, CUDA/cuDNN versions, kernel commit, quant recipe id) and include a manifest so comms/legal can verify.

Sam (marketing): Also need a tiny repro bundle for press: one-page summary, repro script, seeds/sample payloads, histograms CSV, and a README with exact commands.

Priya (eng-runtime): Repro snippet (to be checked into artefact):
```bash
./bench_run.sh --model redwood-2-small --context 1024 --mode single-session --tokens 10000 --quant fp16 --dump-trace
./bench_run.sh --model redwood-2-small --context 1024 --mode single-session --tokens 10000 --quant int8 --dump-trace --repeats 3
```
Will upload traces.

Sam (marketing): Will you include heatmap slices by prompt length? Those help the webinar narrative.

Daniel (eng-runtime): Yes: short <32, medium 32-128, long 128-1024. We'll add per-position heatmaps and split p95 by bucket.

Priya (eng-runtime): Upload target: s3://redwood-marketing/bench-snaps/3618000000-launch-mini/ with summary.pdf, histograms.csv, repro.sh, seeds.txt, manifest.json, raw-traces.tar.gz and CI job link. ETA ~18h.

Riya (marketing): We'll draft the claim sentence and share for approval (avoid sweeping coldstart claims).

BenchBot: Artifact upload started to s3://redwood-marketing/bench-snaps/3618000000-launch-mini/ (upload in progress).
